name: Pause It If You Can
why_it_works: Daring people to freeze a single frame turns watching into a reflex test. They replay, scrub and screenshot, which the algorithm reads as deep interest, and the first person to post the right number gets to feel fast and sharp in front of everyone.

hook.pattern: Tell viewers a number flashes for one frame and challenge them to catch it.
examples: A number flashes in this clip. Pause on it.
Only the fastest thumbs catch the number. Try.
Screenshot the flash. First ten right win.

variables.name: brand
variables.description: Team, athlete, gym or club name

variables.name: action
variables.description: The fast, visual action in the clip
variables.example: a candy-red '64 hopping three feet off the pavement

variables.name: location
variables.example: a sunset parking lot on Whittier Boulevard

variables.name: hidden_number
variables.description: The number that flashes for one beat

variables.name: reward
variables.description: What the first correct commenters get, 4 words or fewer

variables.name: disclosure
variables.description: Required fine print: the giveaway line from compliance/packs.json, plus the client's niche line (fitness: results vary)
variables.example: No purchase necessary. Official rules at link. Results vary.

beats.on_screen_text: A number flashes. Pause on it.
beats.voiceover: A number flashes in this clip. Pause on it.

visual.prompt: Vertical 9:16 dramatic low-angle photo of {{action}} at {{location}}, golden hour backlight, motion frozen mid-moment, crisp detail
Fast, energetic vertical 9:16 sequence of {{action}} at {{location}}, quick camera moves, golden hour light, high contrast, real-world physics

beats.purpose: the flash frame, number as an overlay

visual.prompt: Single vertical 9:16 frame of {{location}} with a clean blank wall or stretch of ground in the center where the number overlay lands, motion blur at the edges, no readable text

beats.voiceover: Caught it? Comment the number. Be honest.

visual.prompt: Vertical 9:16 aftermath shot at {{location}}, dust or chalk hanging in the golden light, the crew or team reacting in silhouette

cta: Comment the number you caught. First ten right get {{reward}} from {{brand}}.

craft.notes: Place the flash right after the most exciting motion, when the eye is still tracking the action, so most people miss it on the first watch. Add the number in the edit as a huge overlay so a paused frame reads instantly on a phone; never let the video model draw it.

do_not: Flash the number for under a second in the final edit; one full second is the floor or nobody can pause on it
Use a flash frame of bright strobing light; avoid rapid flashing that can trigger photosensitive viewers
Show unsafe stunts without a closed course or safety note
compliance: Official rules linked: eligibility, start and end dates, how winners are picked (first ten correct comments by timestamp) and prize value
No purchase necessary; void where prohibited; say it is not sponsored or run by the platform
Fitness: results vary; no guarantee of body or performance results; show safe form and a closed course for any stunt
Avoid rapid strobing in the flash frame for photosensitive viewers
